rules.rule: PR1 preserves complete non-DB and canonical PG scope while separating runner scheduling and requiring complete aggregation.
rules.source: User-approved PR1 and dx-ci-regression-study.md version 2, sections 8, 11 and 16; parent delegation 2026-11-05.
rules.initialization: Shared build is produced before either test lane; each exact checkout verifies tuple, run/attempt, context, plans and all output hashes. PG retains original base seed, roles and independent version/history/restore checks.
rules.dateAndPermission: No production or Acceptance access. Synthetic build-transfer fixtures and protocol reports only; original low-privilege roles, finite test timeouts and canonical worker limits unchanged.
rules.expectation: Missing/cancelled/failed lanes, wrong head/base/run/attempt, changed plans/build bytes, empty results, unauthorized paths and failed cleanup reject aggregation. Existing file-level evidence does not prove an independent case expectation set.
